bns:Component.name: Sub_Generate_CorrelationId
bns:Component.bns:description: UPDATED 2026-11-04: CorrelationId prefix is now InterfaceId (INTERFACE_ID, e.g. S2C_SUP) instead of InterfaceName. | Subprocess for the Endeavour Mining P2P integration framework. Generates CorrelationId (native Set Properties, InterfaceName-timestamp-unique) and TransactionId (Data Process Custom Scripting - UUID.randomUUID(), the framework's one deliberate Groovy exception). RESILIENCE REDESIGN 2026-09-28: no longer writes to EDV_INTEGRATION.TRANSACTION_LOG directly - Database V2 has no connection retry, so a brief SQL Server outage used to silently lose the row. Instead sets LogPhase=START and Process-Calls Sub_Execution_Logger to publish a transaction-start event to Event Streams (topic edv.transaction.log, same pipeline already used for the SUCCESS/ERROR close-out); Sub_TransactionLog_Consumer now does the actual INSERT when it drains the topic. A DB outage delays visibility (bounded by the consumer's schedule) but never loses the record, as long as the publish to Event Streams itself succeeds. Requires InterfaceId/ObjectType/BusinessKey/SourceSystem/TargetSystem/Environment DPPs to already be set by the caller (TEMPLATE_Standard_P2P_Parent does this) - also included in the published event so the consumer's INSERT has everything it needs. Passthrough start so it can be called via Process Call from a parent or run standalone for testing. | built with boomi-companion v1.0.57
